findings.reason: The state-domain supplier defines D_c in dimensionless coordinates and supplies separate maps to physical SI coordinates. This Definition instead writes Ω ⊆ D_c while calling Ω a chart in physical SI coordinates, and uses S_c(U,V,n) without stating the unit-conversion map. Define the physical chart as the image under (U_c,V_c,n_c), and define the physical-coordinate entropy using the inverse map. The local-energy theorem already states this convention explicitly.
